title: Question the Fairness Narrative
description: When analyzing injustice: - Ask: "Is this outcome truly deserved, or am I rationalizing it?" - Empathize: Consider factors outside the victim’s control. - Acknowledge reality: The world isn’t always fair—avoid blaming victims. Example: If someone loses their job unexpectedly, avoid assuming they must have done something wrong.
